privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Processing
privacy.subtitle: Legal compliance for WhatsApp Business API and Personal Data Protection (Law 1581 of 2012 / Meta Platforms).

sections.title: 1. Identity of the Data Controller
sections.content: The party responsible for processing personal data collected through this website and WhatsApp communication is David Agudelo Valencia (hereinafter 'the Controller' or 'David Agudelo'), an individual based in Medellín, Colombia. Contact email: david.agudelo.valencia@gmail.com. Contact WhatsApp: +57 305 258 0913.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.content: Data provided voluntarily by users will be processed for the following purposes:
bullets: Immediate response to inquiries, consulting, and quotes regarding custom software development and web applications.
Scheduling and confirmation of technical discovery sessions and requirements meetings.
Agile digital response to commercial inquiries and proposals.
Commercial follow-up and technical support related to evaluated or contracted projects.

sections.title: 3. Personal Data Collected
sections.content: Through interactions with the website or WhatsApp channels, we only collect necessary information:
bullets: Profile name visible on WhatsApp and name provided during the conversation.
Message content and software requirements sent by the user.
Technical message delivery metadata (timestamp and delivery status provided by Meta).

sections.title: 4. Meta Platforms Integration & Tech Providers
sections.content: For communication, we use the WhatsApp API provided by Meta Platforms, Inc. and secure tools processing requests under rigorous international privacy and security policies. We do not sell, rent, or transfer your personal data to unauthorized third parties.

sections.title: 5. User Rights (Habeas Data / Law 1581 of 2012)
sections.content: Under Colombian legislation (Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013) and international data protection standards, you have the right to:
bullets: Know, update, and rectify your personal data at any time.
Request proof of the authorization granted.
Be informed about how your personal data has been used.
Revoke authorization and/or request deletion of your data from our records.
Access your processed personal data free of charge.

sections.title: 6. Data Deletion Instructions
sections.content: In compliance with Meta Developer Platform requirements and privacy regulations, any user may request immediate and permanent deletion of their personal data via the following channels:
bullets: Sending an email to david.agudelo.valencia@gmail.com with subject 'Personal Data Deletion' indicating your phone number.
Sending a direct message to our WhatsApp (+57 305 258 0913) with the text 'DELETE MY DATA'.
sections.footerNote: Requests will be processed within a maximum of 48 business hours, confirming the irreversible removal of records.

sections.title: 7. Security and Confidentiality
sections.content: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. All communication across WhatsApp and the web is encrypted using industry-standard SSL/TLS protocols.

sections.title: 8. Amendments to the Privacy Policy
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy to reflect legislative updates or technical requirements. The active version will always remain accessible at this URL.

Excellent! We build with modern, scalable stacks (React, Laravel, SQL). What type of company is it?
